writeup: Woot has a new WORKPRO 7500-count staple and brad combo kit (model W023023, UPC 820909758594) for $6.99. The pack is 2,500 1/2-inch T50 staples, 2,500 3/8-inch T50 staples, and 2,500 5/8-inch 18-gauge brads. WORKPRO's own site still has the same kit in stock at $19.99, and eBay has it at $20.99, so this is about $13 and 65 percent below the lowest verified street price. Five or more are left, with a limit of 5 per customer.
